evaluation_protocol.first_gate: Reliability and interpretation of the frozen currently executing reply-contract pair; do not alter or overwrite its evidence.
evaluation_protocol.input_accounting: Bind full native request, selected view, final provider input and independently reconstructed digest/count. Generation schema custody is separately recorded; do not invent a token count from schema bytes or omit harness/tool-turn costs from observed native totals. Exact full-request reconstruction is checked within each arm. Across live trials, verify the same authorized source/declaration populations and reviewed context facts, while retaining separately bound native administrative identities. Do not invent identity equality or apply broad hash/root normalization.
evaluation_protocol.interpretation: Report a matched-pair observation only after all gates pass. Repeat controlled pairs before claiming repeatable savings or equal reliability. No percentage reduction is predicted by this backlog.
evaluation_protocol.live_control: On a newly frozen qualified runtime, use identical original public task inputs, provider/model/reasoning, setup/resource budgets and fixed coding transport plus ordinary coding reply contract in both arms. Vary only the explicit planning acceptance-reference selection.
evaluation_protocol.offline_first: Build authorized public-task fixtures and both complete planning/provider views without a provider call. Bind exact source hashes, projection/reconstruction evidence, schema identities, bytes and explicitly named proxy estimates.

Official reward and original correctness/performance validators
evaluation_protocol.planning_and_coding: Require exactly one receipted LLM planning session and one receipted LLM coding session through llm_router, no fallback, complete plan admission and actual coding contract validation. Retain later native turns and all failed attempt costs.
evaluation_protocol.primary_metric: Sum complete native input_tokens + output_tokens across both sessions and any recorded additional attempts. Do not double-count cumulative native token records or add session summaries again.
evaluation_protocol.unknown_usage: Missing or incomplete final native usage remains unknown, never zero. Unreceipted attempts invalidate a complete saving claim while observed costs remain visible.

findings.fact: Summary index 2 serializes the complete acceptance array, and summary index 3 serializes the complete independently signed task specification containing that same array. This is literal representation redundancy on the direct planning route.

After current preparation and initial-context verification, the provider request receives both verbatim terminal_public_instruction and terminal_planner_task_contract. On the frozen direct route, the typed contract contains the exact acceptance array again. The smallest refreshed treatment can reference that already present structured field.

This typed contract binder currently selects only direct terminal-indexed-public-preparation@1. A first treatment referencing it must reject IntentIR coverage/symbolic and multitask modes rather than assume the field is available there. The earlier design allowed direct or coverage because it referenced the following prose declaration; that broader precondition does not transfer unchanged.

The existing DuckDB query is parameterized and bounded to 1..256 records, deduplicates linked locator rows, and returns false decision/completion/DuckLake authority. Catalog IDs, locators and recorded mtimes are nominations, not source-content freshness proofs or an installed model fact expansion tool.

The generic external owner facade explicitly reports real_owner_bound_gateway_operations_unqualified_fail_closed and canonical_39_operation_owner_handler_unqualified. Do not assume an arbitrary model-facing Quack gateway already exists; qualify a specific typed read operation through a supported live owner path before relying on expansion.

Doctor already uses canonical minified JSON and verifies exact artifact, task, baseline source and matching worktree. It repeats obligation IDs at top level and in rows, while rows may repeat evidence references. A later replacement view can share identical records, but appending another status card would initially increase context.

Declared-input closure is generated after a proposed graph exists, and explicitly declines code semantic closure/proof authority. Existing decision-context completeness and delta reconstruction APIs are reusable, but they are not a preplanning semantic omission certificate or control of native CLI internal history.

Native verdicts include proved, disproved, inconclusive, unsupported, error and cancelled. A compact four-status view must retain the original native verdict/reason so an error or cancellation is not hidden as an ordinary unresolved obligation.
